rci1_using_msad.detail: Multi-site; 3 independent cohorts from at least 6 sites: EMBARC (4 sites: Columbia University, UT Southwestern, University of Michigan, Massachusetts General Hospital), Depression-EEG (University of Arizona), LEMON (University of Leipzig)
rci1_using_msad.supporting_text: "We integrated three cohorts of 154 healthy controls to ensure our healthy norms represent inter-cohort variability and improve the generalizability of our findings." "we developed healthy norms of 154 young adults (age 18-25), which consist of 8 subjects from the EMBARC cohort, 75 subjects from the depression-EEG cohort, and 71 subjects from the LEMON cohort."
rci1_using_msad.location: Tong2024.pdf.md: Methods / 2.1. Participants; Methods / 2.3. Normative modeling of functional connectivity

rci2_using_epd.detail: None of the three cohorts (EMBARC, Depression-EEG, LEMON) are in the established 18-EPD list. All are in-house or study-specific datasets.
rci2_using_epd.supporting_text: "The first cohort consists of 39 healthy subjects from the Establishing Moderators and Biosignatures of Antidepressant Response for Clinical Care (EMBARC) study" "The second cohort consists of 75 healthy subjects from the Depression-EEG cohort" "The third cohort consists of 153 young healthy subjects...from the Leipzig Study for Mind-Body-Emotion Interactions (LEMON) cohort"

rci3_epd_name.detail: RCI-2 = No; no EPD used in normative model construction

rci5_n.detail: Training phase HC; pooled from 3 cohorts: EMBARC (N=8), Depression-EEG (N=75), LEMON (N=71); all young adults aged 18-25
rci5_n.supporting_text: "we developed healthy norms of 154 young adults (age 18-25), which consist of 8 subjects from the EMBARC cohort, 75 subjects from the depression-EEG cohort, and 71 subjects from the LEMON cohort."
rci5_n.location: Tong2024.pdf.md: Methods / 2.3. Normative modeling of functional connectivity

rci6_sex.detail: Training phase; female_n estimated from total N minus reported male_n for each cohort: EMBARC (M=4, F=4), Depression-EEG (M=35, F=40), LEMON (M=41, F=30)

rci7_age.detail: Training phase; weighted mean computed from 3 cohorts: EMBARC (mean=21.6, SD=2.8, N=8), Depression-EEG (mean=19.0, SD=1.2, N=75), LEMON (mean=22.5, SD=NA, N=71). Pooled SD could not be computed because LEMON cohort recorded age at resolution of 5 years (SD unavailable). Age range 18-25 was used as inclusion criterion for demographic matching across cohorts. Age in years.
rci7_age.supporting_text: "Age, yr: 21.6 (2.8) [EMBARC]; 19.0 (1.2) [Depression-EEG]; 22.5 (NA)* [LEMON]" "* The LEMON cohort only recorded age at the resolution of 5." "including healthy controls with age between 18 and 25 was the best way to match demographics of the three independent cohorts."
